q1.explanationZh: 前面讲实验计划，这里要接实验开始的情况：第一次测量后风扇开始工作，温度才会慢慢降下来。

evidence.quote: The plan was to start at 21 degrees Celsius, lower the temperature to 10 degrees, and record how my body would respond.

q2.explanationZh: 后面说手上的血管在收缩，这正好解释了手指为什么会变白，所以填 Next, my fingers turned white。

evidence.quote: The blood vessels in my hands were constricting

q3.explanationZh: 后面说他们又重复测量，说明温度降到10度、风扇已经停了，实验达到了目标。

evidence.quote: I felt uncomfortable as we repeated all the measurements.

q4.explanationZh: 这里说身体更努力地工作，后面讲血压升高、心脏病多发，所以要接一句心脏跳得更快。

evidence.quote: My blood pressure was shooting up while my blood was thickening.

q5.explanationZh: 上文建议穿暖和的衣服，下文说不要光坐着看电视，中间应该是建议多活动来产生热量。

evidence.quote: Do not just sit in a chair and watch TV.
